title: Oozing Smoky Korean Egg Yolk Stew
description: A smoky, monsoon-inspired Jeju dish featuring silky egg yolks and yuzu-cured flavors, sugar-free and low-carb.
instructions: In a medium pot, heat sesame oil over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and sauté until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Stir in sugar-free gochujang and tamari, cooking for 1 minute to bloom flavors.
Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a gentle simmer.
Reduce heat to low, add smoked salt and yuzu zest, stirring to combine.
Crack four egg yolks into the pot, letting them rest in the liquid without stirring.
Allow the stew to simmer uncovered for 5 minutes, until the yolks thicken to a silky consistency.
Taste and adjust seasoning with extra salt if needed.
Transfer the stew to bowls, garnish with sliced scallions and toasted sesame seeds.
Serve hot, ideally with a side of steamed rice or kimchi if desired.
